verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine that exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs (gh-2), so a multi-model serving story applies to it. However, nothing in the pack documents loading several models at once or hot-swapping models in a running server. Choosing a model generation at construction time (docs-22) and model selection in the demo app (comm-17) are adjacent behaviors and do not count as server-side model switching.
